title: Authority-Inference Separation in Agentic Finance: First-Line Control, Blockchain Enforcement, and Replayable Assurance
abstract: arXiv:2608.30519v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents can select tools, counterparties, and transaction parameters, yet inference should not itself confer authority to execute a financial action. This study develops and evaluates Authority-Inference Separation (AIS), an intent-centered architecture for bounded agentic finance. AIS treats a financial action intent as the control object: a machine-generated proposal can receive temporary executable authority only after an independent deterministic control plane validates registered agent identity, accountable ownership, mandate and risk-appetite lineage, policy version, state, approvals, and exact economic semantics. Blockchain can then enforce the operational representation of granted authority and record portable settlement evidence, while institutional legitimacy, service delivery, accounting classification, and human accountability remain off-chain obligations. Evaluation combines four-domain instantiation, official BIS and MAS

translated_title: 智能体金融中的权限-推理分离：一线控制、区块链执行与可重放保障
translated_abstract: AI智能体可以选择工具、交易对手和交易参数，但推理本身不应赋予其执行金融行为的权限。本研究开发并评估了权限-推理分离，这是一种以意图为中心的有界智能体金融架构。AIS将金融行为意图作为控制对象：机器生成的提案只有在独立的确定性控制平面验证了注册智能体身份、可追责的所有权、授权与风险偏好谱系、策略版本、状态、审批以及精确的经济语义之后，才能获得临时的可执行权限。随后，区块链可以执行所授予权限的操作表示并记录可移植的结算证据，而机构合法性、服务交付、会计分类和人类问责仍然是链下义务。评估结合了四领域实例化、官方BIS（国际清算银行）与MAS（新加坡金融管理局）……
tldr: 该论文提出权限-推理分离（AIS）架构，将金融行为意图作为控制对象，规定机器生成的提案必须先经独立确定性控制平面验证身份、授权与风险等要素才能获得临时执行权限，再由区块链执行权限并记录结算证据，从而实现有界智能体金融的可控与可问责。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Authority-Inference Separation (AIS), an intent-centered architecture for bounded agentic finance in which machine-generated proposals gain temporary executable authority only after validation by an independent deterministic control plane, with blockchain enforcing the granted authority and recording portable settlement evidence.
